quickFacts.label: Known For
quickFacts.value: Pristine beaches, excellent snorkeling, peaceful vibe

overview: Located in the breathtaking Lhaviyani Atoll, Olhuvelifushi Island offers visitors an authentic Maldivian experience away from the crowds. This picturesque island combines natural beauty with traditional island life.

Olhuvelifushi is known for its long stretches of pristine beaches, excellent snorkeling spots, and peaceful atmosphere. The island maintains its traditional charm while welcoming visitors with genuine hospitality.
What makes Olhuvelifushi special is its unspoiled environment, rich marine biodiversity, and the opportunity to experience local culture in a relaxed setting.

sections.heading: Location & Map
paragraphs: Olhuvelifushi Island is situated in the northern part of Lhaviyani Atoll, approximately 130 kilometers from Male. This location offers easy access to some of the best dive sites in the Maldives while maintaining a tranquil island atmosphere.
The island's position provides natural protection from strong currents while offering access to vibrant coral reefs and abundant marine life.

sections.heading: Olhuvelifushi: Natural Beauty & Marine Life
paragraphs: Olhuvelifushi Island boasts stunning natural beauty with powder-soft white sand beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and healthy coral reefs teeming with marine life.

sections.heading: Pristine White Sand Beaches
paragraphs: Olhuvelifushi features some of the most beautiful beaches in Lhaviyani Atoll, perfect for relaxation and beach walks.

sections.heading: Excellent Snorkeling
paragraphs: The island's house reef offers easy access to colorful coral formations and diverse marine life.

sections.heading: Authentic Island Culture
paragraphs: Experience genuine Maldivian hospitality and traditional island life.

sections.heading: Sandbank Visits
paragraphs: Explore nearby uninhabited sandbanks for the ultimate tropical island experience.

sections.heading: Activities & Experiences
paragraphs: Olhuvelifushi offers a variety of activities focused on marine adventures, cultural experiences, and relaxation.

sections.heading: Snorkeling Adventures
paragraphs: Explore vibrant coral reefs teeming with tropical fish.

sections.heading: Scuba Diving
paragraphs: Discover world-class dive sites in Lhaviyani Atoll.

sections.heading: Island Hopping
paragraphs: Visit nearby islands to experience different aspects of the Maldives.

sections.heading: Fishing Excursions
paragraphs: Join local fishermen for traditional fishing experiences.

sections.heading: Cultural Experiences
paragraphs: Learn about traditional Maldivian crafts and daily life.

sections.heading: Sunset Cruises
paragraphs: Enjoy breathtaking sunsets over the Indian Ocean.

sections.heading: People & Community Life
paragraphs: Olhuvelifushi is home to a close-knit community of approximately 600 residents who maintain traditional Maldivian ways of life while embracing sustainable tourism.

sections.heading: Daily Life
paragraphs: Life on Olhuvelifushi revolves around fishing, tourism, and community activities. The island has a peaceful rhythm that reflects traditional Maldivian values.

sections.heading: Culture & Traditions
paragraphs: Olhuvelifushi preserves authentic Maldivian cultural traditions including music, dance, and handicrafts. The community celebrates Islamic festivals with enthusiasm.

faqs.question: How do I get to Olhuvelifushi Island?
faqs.answer: There's also a public ferry option that takes 6-7 hours.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Olhuvelifushi?
faqs.answer: The best time is during the dry season from December to April, but Olhuvelifushi can be visited year-round.
